name: [👽NOW] Knife VS Gun DUELS
desc:
🗡️ Welcome to Knife VS Gun DUELS! 💥

👍 Like the game and join the group

How to Play:
⚔️ Step on a pad to start a duel
🗡️ Fight players using knives or guns
💰 Win duels to earn coins
🎁 Use coins to unlock & trade cool items
🔥 Keep winning to build streaks and climb the leaderboard

Have fun and good luck dueling! 🎉
